sections.name: mission
sections.value: Deliver PRD req-0004: close the four verified gaps between pij-rs's live InteractionGate and the TS pane-signals contract — idle expiry, self-echo exemption, fresh send-boundary capture, layout-aware composer recognition. The plan, impl-guide and this packet are AUTHORED BY THE O-PRIME and are the contract; you execute them. Objections are WANTED — raise them AT THE ACK, before any coder builds, never after implementations accumulate.

value.text: FIRST: read plan.dd.json, impl-guide.dd.json (same folder) and PRD row req-0004 (.harness/government/prd/base-prd.dd.md on branch prime-governance). ACK back to pij-dominant-vicuna with objections or 'ack clean' BEFORE dispatching anything.

Load BOTH the /pij skill and the /builder skill, and require the same of every coder and reviewer you spawn — work runs through /builder verbs (coders: /builder 6 implement; reviewer: /builder 7 review), acting from the packet contracts, never improvised from CLI help.

You code NOTHING in wave 1. Dispatch u-gate and u-observer to two coders in parallel per the impl-guide: omp, model github-copilot/gpt-5.6-sol-fast-1m, effort high — verify the exact model id with `pij models` at dispatch time, never hardcode from memory. Each coder: own worktree off s111/anti-step-on, own tmux WINDOW (never a pane beside anyone), own CARGO_TARGET_DIR, packet-coder ddoc you author FROM the impl-guide unit row (quote the frozen interface verbatim), instructed to ACK with objections before building.

RED-FIRST is non-negotiable: ac-1111's witness must be run and seen FAILING on the pre-fix tree, with the red output pasted into the receipt, before the fix lands. A regression test green from birth is a claim, not a witness.
You own composition (phase ph-1112) per the impl-guide composition section, on s111/anti-step-on. Coders never merge; you merge.

Receipts discipline: every plan AC gets its receipt field filled with a re-executable receipt (test name + tree sha, or run id). Report receipts to pij-dominant-vicuna as they land — the o-prime checks off the PRD row, you never touch the governance branch.

Gate: `~/.cargo/bin/cargo run -p pij-testkit --bin pij-gate` (the BARE cargo on this machine is a non-rustup 1.95 and fails the toolchain pin — see docs/plans/110-claude-delivery/assets/toolchain-note.md). All stages green before review.

Daemon restart rule: if you smoke-test against the live rs daemon, remember it runs a compiled binary — rebuild and restart it for your change to take effect, and NEVER borrow a live operator surface without an explicit window from the o-prime.
Status cards: pij report now at the start and end of every unit of work, and chase your coders' stale cards — their rot is your accountability.
o-prime: pij-dominant-vicuna. Escalations, rulings, human asks route through it — you never ask Jordan directly; persist the pending decision and continue non-dependent work.

Reviewer (phase ph-1113): cross-model from the coder family — coder is gpt-5.6-sol, so reviewer must NOT be a gpt-5.6 variant; pick claude or gemini class from `pij models`. Reviewer re-derives verdicts by EXECUTION (runs the tests, applies the mutations), never by reading. The flow-pair `review` CLI verb fabricates verdicts — hand-persist the real verdict into the plan assets.
Peers are pij-blind at boot: every packet you send bakes in the recipient's id, your id, and the exact `pij send <you>` reply form.

value.text: All six plan ACs receipted (re-executable receipts in plan.dd.json), ac-1111 witnessed red-first.
Both mutation proofs fire (idle-expiry revert, echo-match loosening) and are recorded in the plan assets.
pij-gate green via the rustup cargo; fmt, clippy -D warnings, full workspace tests.

PR OPEN against main from s111/anti-step-on with the receipts in its description, and GitHub CI GREEN on the PR — the work is not done at 'code complete'; it is done when the PR exists and its checks pass. Do not merge; merge is the o-prime's call with Jordan.
Cross-model review verdict persisted in docs/plans/111-anti-step-on/assets/ before the PR is marked ready.
Coder worktrees reaped by whoever created them; findings doc in assets/ (instrument failures included, honestly).
